svg.title: OLTP vs OLAP
svg.desc: Left, the order service reads and writes single rows in a row store, each in milliseconds. An hourly job copies the same data into a column store. Right, one analytics query scans only the city, time and delivery columns over millions of rows, and checkout never slows down.
svg.text: Apps touch a few rows. Analytics scans a few columns, in a separate store.
